config_required_each_command.attachTarget: <known target OR omit with discoverExisting:true; mutually exclusive>

ref_rule: Fresh per-snapshot refs; exact node/frame/document/URL/meaning guard; no role/name/nth fallback; selector roots exclude descendants of every in-scope AX ancestor, including virtual/ignored nodes, so each ref is rendered once
input_rule: Before strict fill/type, activate only the bound parent page via Page.bringToFront, recheck exact ref identity, then retain Document.hasFocus and native deep focus guards. A confirmed native focus rejection before clear/insert returns FOCUS_CHANGED with executed:false; transport failures and post-input drift stay outcome_unknown. No replay. Type rejects Tab/CR/LF; literal fill for multiline; no unconfirmed checkbox second click
rebind_rule: Explicit same-connection target selection only; no fallback. Failed persistence blocks commands. Explicit reconnect is the only new-WS recovery and is never automatic.
retry_rule: Strict CLI transport at most once; no daemon respawn/replay after transport failure; outcome_unknown stops automatic retry

local_verify.command: verify --expected-url URL --expected-text TEXT [--ref @eN --expected-value VALUE] through private stdin
local_verify.predicates: At least one; all supplied predicates must match
local_verify.value: Exact native input/textarea/select value including empty; contenteditable value unsupported

bootstrap.selection: Explicit fullcase-sensitive pagetargetID; firstselection binds cachedmetadata aftersingleattach/setup withoutfocus/getURL/getTitle

local_GUI_titles.boundaries: MCP andWSS rejectlocal-label requests; onlylocalGUI projectionreceives title

crowdworks_inspection.scope: Explicit selected strict target; HTTPS crowdworks.jp or www.crowdworks.jp /public/jobs subtree. No fallback target or generic eval.
crowdworks_inspection.output: origin, candidates:{cw_N:{href,label,context}}, text, coverage; IDs never grant action authority
crowdworks_inspection.complete: Full bounded main/light-DOM output only; unsupported or overflow returns no partial data. One pierced DOM capture may contain descendant metadata before projection.
crowdworks_inspection.guards: Exact target and strict document identity before/after; queued iframe initialization/resume excluded; mixed-job card contexts rejected.
crowdworks_inspection.unverified: Real CrowdWorks layouts and Windows bridge.4 execution

connection_failure_diagnostics.scope: Optional fixed stage on strict launch with code unavailable only; no replay or connection changes
connection_failure_diagnostics.compatibility: code and data.executed retain their existing meaning; older pinned helpers omit the optional field
connection_failure_diagnostics.privacy: Exact static internal messages only; no exception text, URL, headers, target IDs or browser response payloads
connection_failure_diagnostics.errors: Each stage distinguishes timeout from error; error does not imply a permission refusal
